title: Not So Minimal Warm Inflation
summary: An axion-like inflaton coupled to non-Abelian gauge bosons provides a compelling microphysical framework for warm inflation. Starting even from cold initial conditions, in these systems, sphaleron heating may generate thermal friction sufficient to sustain finite temperatures throughout the inflationary epoch. Insisting on shift-symmetric potentials, in this work we revisit the viability of these scenarios under the designation of Minimal Warm Inflation.
